remarks: This very spacious two-family home offers 3,392 sq ft of living space. Unit 1 has 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, eat in kitchen, large living room with fireplace, hardwood floors, partially finished basement, and a 1 car garage. Unit 2 has 3 bedrooms, 1 bath, eat in kitchen, large living room, walk up attic, and hardwood floors. Each unit has its own hot water heater, furnace, separate utilities, and laundry hookup. In addition to the garage there are 4 off street parking spaces.
